source_review: B25DC0 result is published to actual head before sentinel byte1. Each parent/left/right initialization reloads current head separately; count is cleared before actual atexit registration. Word0 is untouched. Setup borrows caller storage and invalid domain; it does not initialize raw bytes.

The shutdown captures actual head and its minimum before composing first/last checked iterators. It calls the exact complete range helper, then frees the current head and clears current head/count after returning free. The hidden native tail CE0C7C..CE0C8F is included in the full64-byte span.

Bound tree/domain globals are persistent host setup identities, not a private replacement tree. One actual mapped108D530 header and the persistent callback domain survive true process exit in both modes.

Native EAX0 is established by complete instructions XOR EAX,EAX followed by the two absolute stores and RET. The new source exposes a void callback; the fixture does not claim its unspecified EAX equals native.
No silent fixture workaround or production source correction was needed. New initializer/destructor lack noexcept and the bounded allocation-failure marker propagates normally before registration.

fixture.native_operation_execution: Each native process invokes original CD7960 with its complete64-byte body. It registers the actual relocated original CE0C50 pointer with real host std::atexit. Returning from main lets CRT invoke this exact complete64-byte native shutdown body.
fixture.atexit_service: The BF6FF5 bridge calls real std::atexit. The observed _crt_atexit IAT entry validates the exact native CE0C50 or exact linked production destroy_static_native_hardware_layout_tree_00ce0c50 callback then forwards it immediately to the actual imported CRT function. It stores no substitute callback list and never manually invokes the tree shutdown.
fixture.validator_order: A real after-tree validator is registered before initializer registration; a real before-tree observer is registered after successful initialization. CRT LIFO exit order runs before-tree, genuine tree callback, then after-tree validator. Allocation-failure processes register only the after-tree validator. Persistent State/header/domain remain alive until that validator completes.
fixture.helper_bridge_scope: Native B25DC0 and B2F3A0 entries bridge their exact native ABIs to the already complete linked production sentinel allocator and range erase; BF65AC bridges actual shared free. These dependencies are shared on the two sides and are not independently compared again. Their separate native lifetime/tree fixtures establish their behavior.
fixture.patch_boundary: Twelve absolute operands inside the two static bodies plus the captured CRT initializer pointer at CE3504 are rebased, and four captured5-byte helper/CRT entry preimages receive explicit relative JMP bridges. All other static instruction bytes and relative CALL displacements remain original; no owned operation body is replaced.
fixture.header_watch: The actual relocated108D530 header page becomes read-only during init and true shutdown. A vectored write-fault and one-instruction single step record each store offset, actual PC and post-store raw header/live-node state. Native init writes occur at CD796A/CD798F; final native shutdown head/count stores occur at CE0C81/CE0C86. Host stores are verified inside exact primary static-object symbol ranges.
fixture.normalization: Only actual header and nine actual node pointer identities are normalized. Raw word0/count, full node key bytes/value/color/sentinel/padding and ordered allocation/free/registration/return/new-handler events are retained.

scenarios.limit: These deliberate free-service perturbations verify current loads and post-free clearing; they are not normal CRT free side effects.

scenarios.name: allocation_failure
scenarios.result: One malloc40 request is made to fail; the existing actual shared allocator calls installed new handler which throws a marker. No tree callback is registered, no node is freed, and actual header word0/head/count retain caller bytes.

limits: This compares the complete two static bodies and real process-exit sequencing, not original CRT global state or its whole initialization dispatcher.
CE3504 is byte-verified and rebased as evidence; the fixture invokes the static initializer explicitly rather than executing the entire original initializer interval.
Registration failure/no-rollback behavior is established by source and full instruction ordering; real CRT registration exhaustion was not forced.
Native sentinel/range/free helper behaviors are existing shared dependencies, not independent native closure execution in this static-only comparison.
Allocation null-success, arbitrary malformed trees, concurrent rebinding and invalid callback lifetimes are outside the valid borrowed-storage contract.
No native ABI replacement, whole-game startup, runtime gameplay or rendering claim.
